title: Fibrancy of finite iterated pullback towers
statement:
Use small simplicial sets and Kan complexes as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $B$ and $E$ be Kan complexes and let $s,t:E\to B$ be Kan fibrations, meaning maps with the right lifting property against every horn inclusion $\Lambda_i^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$ for $n\geq1$ and $0\leq i\leq n$. Define $P_1=E$ with endpoint map $t$, and recursively
$$P_k=P_{k-1}\times_{B,t_{k-1},s}E,$$
where $t_{k-1}:P_{k-1}\to B$ is the endpoint map of the last $E$ coordinate. Then every $P_k$ is a Kan complex, for $k\geq2$ the projection $P_k\to P_{k-1}$ is a Kan fibration, and its endpoint map $t_k:P_k\to B$ is a Kan fibration. No nonemptiness hypothesis is imposed on $B$, $E$ or the pullbacks; $k$ ranges over positive integers.
